editions.designation_note: One text under three covers. IEEE's page for 1003.1-2024 (standards.ieee.org, read 2026-11-13) says it is simultaneously IEEE Std 1003.1-2024 and The Open Group Base Specifications Issue 8, and lists the ISO/IEC/IEEE 9945 International Standard with the same Issue 8 title. ISO/IEC/IEEE 9945:2026 (edition 2, 2026-03, replacing the 2009 first edition) is known only from search-result snippets: iso.org answered HTTP 403 to an automated fetch, so its date and its identity with this HTML are not verified from the primary page. It is sold; this collection neither holds nor imports it.
